title: Ninja ZX-4RR KRT 4-Cylinder (Pro Spec)
description: Representing Kawasaki's engineering ethos in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-4RR KRT 4-Cylinder (Pro Spec) is engineered for responsive agility and high-rpm engine exhilaration. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
